traps.why: That is the thiol. The crown-ether reagent delivers a different 'naked' anion (F⁻, CN⁻ or acetate).

explanation: 18-Crown-6 wraps the K⁺ and leaves the anion bare and highly nucleophilic in the organic solvent: a clean SN2 on the alkyl halide.
tip: Crown ether frees the anion; the product is just the SN2 product.
